title: Hurry up!
evenTitle: Are there any ...? Is there any ...?

lines.speaker: Penny
lines.en: Can you make the tea, Sam?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Yes, of course I can, Penny.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Is there any water in this kettle?

lines.speaker: Penny
lines.en: It's over there, behind the teapot.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: but I can't see the tea.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Ah yes, I can see it now.

lines.speaker: Penny
lines.en: There are some in the cupboard.

drills.en: I can see some spoons, but I can't see any ___.
drills.zh: 我能看见一些勺子，但看不到刀。

drills.en: I can see some hammers, but I can't see any ___.
drills.zh: 我能看见一些锤子，但看不到盒子。

drills.en: I can see some cupboards, but I can't see any ___.
drills.zh: 我能看见一些碗橱，但看不到架子。

drills.en: I can see some cups, but I can't see any ___.
drills.zh: 我能看见一些杯子，但看不到盘子。

drills.en: Is there any bread here? Yes, there is. There's ___ on the table.
drills.zh: 这儿有面包吗？有，桌上有一些。

drills.en: Are there ___ hammers here? Yes, there are.
Can you make the tea, Sam? Yes, ___ course I can.
drills.zh: 你会沏茶吗，萨姆？会的，我当然会。
